original.target_description: Experiment 5: participant-based (F1) main effect of switch versus stay trials on correct reading-aloud response time, across regular words and nonwords; 16 University of Waterloo undergraduates.

n.sample_role: Participants in Experiment 5 participant-based repeated-measures RT analysis; no participant exclusions reported. The RT analysis also reports F1(1, 15) for stimulus type.
n.exclusions: Trials excluded for incorrect pronunciation (6.1%) or voice-key failure (5.5%); a further 1.8% of correct RT data removed by trimming. No participant exclusions reported.

notes:
Replication values are supplied/derived by primary project authors, extracted without conversion. Table character encoding is cp1252; effect metric glyphs preserved as supplied. N (R) is not assumed to be analytic n. 
Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation using the supplied published-article text; title, authors, year and DOI match the assigned reference. Locator p.7 corresponds to PDF p.7 / printed p.56. Requested η² retained as printed for the participant-based switch-cost main effect. No numerical p value or p bound is printed for this test; F1 < 1 is not converted to a p bound. The separate by-item analysis reports F2 < 1, η² < .001. The source reports no participant removals, and participant-based RT denominator df=15 supports the 16-person analytic sample. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
